description.value: You have large and extended tuft feathers that drape down to your shins. By ruffling your feathers you can interlace them, closing any gaps to act as a parachute. So long as you are not @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.3CQC3JEY2C3Y721F]{Incapacitated} or @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.1EK5V6KTYAWC6S69]{Restrained}, you can make and use them as a parachute to prevent yourself from taking falling damage.
